About Me

My name is Ahmed Samir, a Digital Marketing Specialist & Web Developer based in Sana'a, Yemen. I plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across Meta and Google — and I build the websites and tracking stacks those campaigns land on.

From an electronics store in Shu'aub to an auto-parts store in Saudi Arabia and a honey e-commerce brand selling to the US market, I connect creative, targeting and analytics into one growth system: Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager and GA4 measuring every riyal and dollar.

Let's combine strategy, creative and data to build a powerful digital footprint for your brand. I'm ready to help you scale!
